description: Follow Germany's politicians with abgeordnetenwatch.de: search the members and candidates of the Bundestag, the state parliaments and the European Parliament, see the seats they won and the elections they stood in, how each of them and each parliamentary group voted in every roll-call vote, their committees, and the side jobs and extra income Bundestag members declare. Start a workflow when a parliament holds a new roll-call vote or a new side job is declared. No account or API key required.

abgeordnetenwatch_new_poll_trigger.description: Runs when abgeordnetenwatch.de publishes a new roll-call vote (namentliche Abstimmung) of a parliament, with its result: how many voted yes, no or abstained, and how each parliamentary group voted. Optionally only votes on one topic.

output.accepted: True when the motion was accepted.
output.by_fraction: How each parliamentary group voted, the largest first.
output.committees: The committees that brought it to the vote.
output.intro: abgeordnetenwatch.de's summary of what was decided, in German, as plain text.
output.links: Further reading abgeordnetenwatch.de links to, such as the motion.
output.parliament_id: The ID of the parliament watched.
output.parliament_period_id: The parliament period's ID, such as 161 for the Bundestag 2025 to 2029.
output.poll_id: The roll-call vote's ID, which 'Get a roll-call vote's result' and 'List how members voted' take.
output.title: What was voted on, in German.
output.topics: The topics it is filed under.
output.vote_count: Members whose vote is recorded, including absences.

parameters.description: The parliament to watch, such as the Bundestag.
parameters.name: parliament

parameters.description: Only votes on this topic, such as the environment. Leave blank for every vote.
parameters.name: topic

abgeordnetenwatch_new_side_job_trigger.description: Runs when abgeordnetenwatch.de records a new side job a Bundestag member declared (a Nebentätigkeit), with the organization, category and income where published. Optionally only one politician's, one party's members' or one category's.

output.category: The Bundestag's category code, such as '29647'.
output.category_label: The category in words, such as 'Paid work alongside the mandate'.
output.country: The country, in German, such as 'Deutschland'.
output.declared_at: When abgeordnetenwatch.de first recorded it, in UTC (ISO 8601).
output.details: Further details, in German, such as 'Brutto' (gross).
output.income: The income declared, in euros, where the exact amount is published.
output.income_interval: How often it is paid: one-off, monthly or yearly.
output.income_level: The income band, such as '€3,500 to €7,000', where a band is published.
output.income_total: The income added up to a date, in euros, where published.
output.income_total_date: The date that total runs to.
output.job_title: The job, in German, as the Bundestag published it.
output.job_title_extra: More on it, such as the period the income is for, in German.
output.mandate_ids: The mandates it was declared under.
output.organization: The company, association or body it is for.
output.topics: The topics it is filed under.
